en.aglaope:
* Unlike Nandi, the minion *must* be the Scarlet Peacock.
* The Scarlet Peacock can be crafted by 'Weavers' using a Scarlet Tailfeather dropped in Hells' Kier (Extreme), or off the Market Board for Gil.
* You can be mounted while traveling over the spawn locations as long as the Scarlet Peacock was summoned prior to mounting. If you disconnect or log-in already mounted, you'll need to dismount once to let the game automatically summon it again before re-mounting.
* You do not have to be on the ground to trigger a spawn, you can fly at any altitude as long as you go over the spawn locations below.
en.agrippa_the_mighty:
* All maps that can offer Mor Dhona as a destination can spawn Agrippa. This includes Boarskin, Peisteskin and Toadskin ones, as well as Unhidden Leather Maps.
* These maps are all obtained via the daily gathering allowance, or off the Market Board for Gil. Remember that you can use the world visit system to buy off other world's Market Boards! Use this to shop for cheaper maps elsewhere.
* Mysterious Maps can also be used, but are only available if you have progressed to the Alexandrite (Books) stage of an A Realm Reborn relic weapon. They are purchasable for 75 Poetics each from Auriana at 'Revenant's Toll'.
* The chance to get Mor Dhona from a single map is very low (around 6%). You will often need to decipher and discard multiple maps until you see one.
* Mailing maps around is a way to bypass the unique requirement on them. Doing this with enough peoples daily allowances will allow you to stockpile maps in advance. You can also store one map in your 'Chocobo Saddlebag' and have one deciphered in your 'Key Items' as well, for a total of three on hand at once.
en.arch_aethereater:
* The 'Crystal Incarnation' mobs have a chance of spawning when the zone's S-Rank dies. You will know they have spawned when the system message ``The minions of an extraordinarily powerful mark are on the hunt for prey...`` appears in your chat after killing the S-Rank. They will spawn in the four locations represented as blue dots on the map page.
* Once engaged, the minions will withdraw if they leave combat (i.e. they are reset or all players fighting it have died). If any withdraw, you will see another system message ``The minions of an extraordinarily powerful mark have withdrawn...`` and the SS-Rank will not appear.
* It's recommended that the S-Rank groups split up and engage the minions at the same time. Once engaged, you no longer have to worry about the time limit as long as they stay in combat. When your minion is killed, you can go and assist with other minions that still have high HP, or head to where the SS-Rank will spawn represented as the large red dot on the map page. Groups will tend to shout the HP status of their minions so you can keep track.
en.archaeotania:
* The Archaeotania encounter requires the completion of five FATEs in The Tempest to begin, split across two FATE chains:
1.
	1. 'Where Has The Dagon' (``24,21``) Teushs Ooan
	2. 'Ondo of Blood' (``29,12``) Teushs Ooan
	3. 'Lookin' Back on the Track' (``24,18``) Teushs Ooan
2.
	1. 'Coral Support' (``35,9``) Teushs Ooan
	2. 'Low Coral Fiber' (``36,5``) Teushs Ooan
* The order of completion does not matter, as long as all FATEs are completed successfully.
* The encounter consists of two individual FATES.  If Archaeotania is ready to spawn, 'Nothing Like a Trappin' Life' starts the chain, and it continues to 'The Head, the Tail, the Whole Damned Thing' after it has successfully completed.  There is no significant delay between the two FATEs, so they are treated as a single encounter on Faloop with two stages.
* If 'Nothing Like a Trappin' Life' fails, the whole encounter is considered failed and the window is closed.
en.armstrong:
* Both items need to be equipped, and they are obtained from the Main Scenario Quest Dressed for Conquest.  If you no longer have them, you can purchase them back from any Calamity Salvager.
* Armstrong can spawn even if your gear is broken.  There's no need to repair it constantly.
* Remember to set your home point to the aetherytes in the zone to speed up your spawn attempts.
* If you cannot die to a mob near a location, you can use the Blue Mage ability 'Self Destruct' which is learnt from Bomb-type enemies that use the same named action. The most common location to learn this is off 'Glide Bombs' outside Copperbell Mines in 'Western Thanalan'. Attack them until they are at low HP and they will use it to KO themselves.  Remember you do *not* have to be hit by the ability to learn it as a Blue Mage, just simply witnessing the ability being used is good enough. It may take several attempts to succeed.
* Self Destruct also leaves a 10 minute debuff on you which prevents using the action repeatedly ('Brush with Death'), however you can clear this by using the Duty Finder and quickly joining and leaving a duty solo by undersizing it.
en.atticus_the_primogenitor:
* This item is craftable as a 'Culinarian' with a Level 99 recipe using the following ingredients:
	* '1'x  Turali Corn Oil
	* '1'x  Mountain Salt
	* '1'x  Rroneek Chuck
	* '1'x  Dragon Pepper
	* '2'x  Yyasulani Garlic
	* '1'x  Night Vinegar
	* '8'x  Fire Crystal
	* '8'x  Water Crystal
* All of these ingredients can also be purchased off of the Market Board for gil.
* The item *must* be crafted as high-quality. Normal quality will not work.
* It doesn't matter where in the zone you craft the item. Even if you're right by the Aetheryte, it will count.
en.behemoth:
* As there is no specific spawn trigger, there is no way to directly cause this FATE to spawn. You will need to camp and wait in the zone during the open window.
* The Behemoth encounter consists of two individual boss FATES. 'Behold Now Behemoth' starts the chain, and it continues to 'He Taketh with His Eyes' immediately after the first FATE is complete. There is no significant delay between two FATEs, short of the time it takes Behemoth to travel to the location of the second FATE. As such, they are treated as a single encounter on Faloop with two stages.
* Behemoth's two FATEs actually appear on the map, and they only have a single static location, so it is easier than the other FATEs to check if it has spawned.
* Behemoth has very weak scaling. These days players can do considerable damage to it and end the encounter quickly, similar to older S-ranks. Please take extra care waiting for stragglers to arrive so they don't miss out.
en.bird_of_paradise:
* Bird of Paradise's trigger is on the ability being used. You do not need to get hit by the ability, nor do more people getting hit increase the chances of a spawn.
* This mark is very easy to work on while AFK. Just initiate and keep Squonk in combat. A tank job, Scholar pet or chocobo can easily outheal the damage it deals.
* Remember that other players might need to kill Squonk for their weekly mark bill. Be courteous! B Rank marks respawn immediately, it won't take long to find it again. 🙂
en.bone_crawler:
* It doesn't matter which route is taken, as long as it crosses the divide between the northern and southern parts of the zone. This includes routes that can take you out of the zone, or ones that send you into the zone from a neighbouring zone.
* Transporting between 'Ala Ghiri' and 'Ala Gannha' is the recommended route. Not only is it the cheapest one to save on gil, but it's also the fastest and avoids any loading screens.
* You can use the 'Dismount' action bar button to prematurely land and end the journey once you're over valid ground. So if your spawn attempt is successful, you don't have to wait until you arrive at your destination to get off.
* Also, if you've passed the middle of the zone without a spawn, you can queue into any duty (such as the Gold Saucer Battlehall) and leave immediately to instantly reset your journey to before the middle crossing.  Each time you do this, it counts as a separate attempt without incurring a gil cost!  It also saves a you marginal amount of time compared to waiting until you reached your destination normally.
en.bonnacon:
* La Noscean Leeks can be harvested at 'The Flock' (Slot 6) with 'Truth of the Forests' active between the Eorzean hours of 8AM and 11AM.
* At least 408 Gathering is required to harvest.
* GP is best spent on as many 'Ageless Words' uses as you can in order to maximise the amount of spawn chances per node.
* Bonnacon's trigger is on the act of harvesting, not on the time period involved. It is possible to keep the gathering window open and space out spawn attempts to other Eorzean hours of the day. This can be advantageous if you have to AFK and a lot of other people's spawn attempts have already failed, or to hold the last node prior to the window opening until after it opens.
en.brontes:
* Any kind of food and drink can spawn him, both normal and high quality.
* Cheap, vendor-bought food like Boiled Eggs and Raisins are recommended.
* Food can be eaten while mounted.
* If your spawn attempt is successful, Brontes will appear immediately after you use the item on the spawn location. The possible spawn area around the location is deceptively large, so be sure to check behind you!
en.burfurlur_the_canny:
* Like Gamma, a specific minion is required and *must* be the Tiny Troll. Also it can only spawn between the Eorzean hours of 9AM and 5PM.
* Unlike Gamma however, the weather in the zone must *also* be either Clear or Fair Skies.  Burfurlur will not spawn in the rain or when it's cloudy.
* The Tiny Troll is a rare drop from the final boss in The Aitiascope.
* You can be mounted while traveling over the spawn locations as long as the Tiny Troll was summoned prior to mounting. If you disconnect or log-in already mounted, you'll need to dismount once to let the game automatically summon it again before re-mounting.
* You do not have to be on the ground to trigger a spawn, you can fly at any altitude as long as you go over the spawn locations below.
en.chernobog:
* If you have a class of a low enough level, the quickest way to die repeatedly is by aggroing and dying to the raptors directly outside of 'Camp Overlook'.
* Higher-leveled classes who have Blue Mage unlocked can use the Blue Magic action 'Self-destruct' to instantly kill themselves. While this does leave a 10 minute debuff on you which prevents using the action repeatedly ('Brush with Death'), you can clear this by using the Duty Finder and quickly joining and leaving a duty solo as an Unrestricted Party.
* If you don't have Self-destruct available or don't want to constantly queue for duties, other options involve level syncing and dying in FATEs, or you can attempt to aggro a raptor above the Kobold camp before jumping off and dying to falling damage.
* Remember to set your home point to Camp Overlook before doing anything else!
* This is also a good opportunity to get your The Kindness of Strangers V achievement and 'Good Samaritan' title if you don't have it. Resurrect your comrades as they die repeatedly!
en.chi:
* 'Omicron Recall: Killing Order' requires the completion of two FATEs in Ultima Thule to spawn, that appear in sequence as a chain:
1. 'Omicron Recall: Comms Expansion' (``29,25``) N-6205
2. 'Omicron Recall: Secure Connection' (``32,26``) N-6205
* After the first FATE is completed, the second FATE can take up to 30 minutes to appear.
* The order of completion does not matter, as long as both FATEs are completed successfully. If Chi is ready to spawn, 'Omicron Recall: Killing Order' will usually appear within minutes after completing the last one (although it can take longer on rare occasions). This will not occur while the window is closed, and is also not guaranteed to occur while the window is in progress.
* Be quick to get involved in the second FATE as it is a defense FATE. While it has the standard 15min time limit, it *can* fail in the first 5 minutes if left alone.
en.coeurlregina:
* As there is no specific spawn trigger, there is no way to directly cause the FATEs to spawn. You will need to camp and wait in the zone during the open windows.
* When any of the three Coeurlregina FATEs spawn, the weather in The Dravanian Forelands will change to 'Royal Levin'. This is a unique weather condition that will always override the normal weather while the FATE is present. For Part 1 and Part 2, the sky color of 'Royal Levin' will be green. For Part 3, 'Royal Levin' skies will be red.
* The only way to progress through the parts is to successfully complete the previous ones. Progression is not instant; Parts 2 and 3 have their own windows that begin when the previous part was successful. If you fail or a FATE times out, progress resets back to Part 1.
* Like other boss FATEs, all three FATEs do not appear on the map, only on the minimap as you near their locations.
* Part 1 only has a single static location just outside Tailfeather where you face off against smaller minions. Coeurlregina herself won't appear until later.
* Part 2 & 3 have you facing off against Coeurlregina herself, and each part has multiple possible spawn locations. Use the color of the sky to figure out which locations to scout. You will be able to see her from any distance away.
en.croakadile:
* The full moon phase lasts four Eorzean days and Croakadile is spawnable between 5PM and 3AM on the nights of all four.
* Croakadile and Mindflayer are unique in that they have no known window duration; they open and cap at the same time, guaranteeing a spawn when both the window is open and the condition is active.
* The Eorzean moon takes just over 37 real-time hours to cycle completely. Since Croakadile's window cooldown is 50 hours, you're guaranteed a spawn every second full moon. Simply waiting until 5PM on the first night and then travelling over the spawn locations is enough to trigger a spawn at one of them.
* For the first spawn after a maintenance, it's possible the window may open when the condition is active (or close to activating). Since determining the maintenance restart time is an inexact science, you may have to make a few trips around the zone during the active condition before you get a spawn.
* You can be mounted while traveling over the spawn locations.
* You do not have to be on the ground to trigger a spawn, you can fly at any altitude as long as you go over the spawn locations below.
en.croque_mitaine:
* Grade 3 La Noscean Topsoil can be mined at 'La Thagran Checkpoint' (Slot 8) with 'Truth of the Mountains' active between the Eorzean hours of 7PM and 10PM.
* At least 353 Gathering is required to mine.
* Unlike Bonnacon's node, the Topsoil slot is rare. You get only one chance to spawn per node.
* Yield-increasing abilities like 'Bountiful Yield' and 'King's Yield' do not affect rare slots. Don't waste your GP!
* Croque-mitaine's trigger is on the act of mining, not on the time period involved. It is possible to keep the gathering window open and space out spawn attempts to other Eorzean hours of the day. This can be advantageous if you have to AFK and a lot of other people's spawn attempts have already failed, or to hold the last node prior to the window opening until after it opens.
en.daivadipa:
* 'Devout Pilgrims vs. Daivadipa' requires the completion of two FATEs in Thavnair to spawn, that appear in sequence as a chain:
1. 'Devout Pilgrims vs. the Jungle Lizards' (``34,27``)
2. 'Devout Pilgrims vs. the Apalala' (``23,23``)
* After the first FATE is completed, the second FATE should appear within minutes.
* Then, if Daivadipa is ready to spawn, 'Devout Pilgrims vs. Daivadipa' will appear within minutes after completing the second FATE.  This will not occur while the window is closed, and is also not guaranteed to occur while the window is in progress.
* Be quick to get involved in the first FATE as it is a defense FATE.  While is has the standard 15min time limit, it *can* fail in the first 5 minutes if left alone.
en.forgiven_pedantry:
* Dwarven Cotton Bolls can be harvested at 'Scree' just south of 'Tomra'.
* Unlike other gathering-related S-Ranks, this is not a timed node. It can be harvested at anytime, even on other worlds!
* The quota is for the number of successful gathering attempts, *not* on the number of items received. +yield nodes give no additional contribution. So spending GP on as many 'Ageless Words' uses as you can will help meet it sooner.
* As with all quota triggers, a spawn after exactly 50 gathering attempts is not guaranteed if the window has not yet capped. Also a successful spawn attempt can occur before you complete all 50, due to other player activity in the zone counting towards it.
en.forgiven_rebellion:
* The 'Forgiven Gossip' mobs have a 10% chance of spawning when the zone's S-Rank dies. You will know they have spawned when the system message ``The minions of an extraordinarily powerful mark are on the hunt for prey...`` appears in your chat after killing the S-Rank. They will spawn in the four locations represented as blue dots on the map page.
* All four have to be engaged in combat within five minutes or else they will withdraw. Once engaged, they will also withdraw if they leave combat (i.e. they are reset or all players fighting it have died). If any withdraw, you will see another system message ``The minions of an extraordinarily powerful mark have withdrawn...`` and the SS-Rank will not appear.
* It's recommended that the S-Rank groups split up and engage the minions at the same time. Once engaged, you no longer have to worry about the time limit as long as they stay in combat. When your minion is killed, you can go and assist with other minions that still have high HP, or head to where the SS-Rank will spawn represented as the large red dot on the map page. Groups will tend to shout the HP status of their minions so you can keep track.
* When engaging the minions with low numbers, be extra careful with their gaze attack so you don't get killed immediately after the petrification. A tank can survive fighting a minion indefinitely solo if they always avoid the gaze attack, so don't be afraid to pull it right away with a tank available.
en.formidable:
* 'A Finale Most Formidable' requires the completion of two FATEs in Kholusia to spawn, that appear in sequence as a chain:
1. 'Foes Most Formidable' (``22,14``)
2. 'Family Most Formidable' (``25,21``)
* After the first FATE is completed, the second FATE should appear within minutes.
* Then, if Formidable is ready to spawn, 'A Finale Most Formidable' will appear within minutes after completing the second FATE.  This will not occur while the window is closed, and is also not guaranteed to occur while the window is in progress.
* Be quick to get involved in the first two FATEs as they are defense FATEs.  While they have the standard 15min time limit, they *can* fail in the first 5 minutes if left alone.
en.gamma:
* Unlike Nandi, the minion *must* be the Toy Alexander. Also it can only spawn between the Eorzean hours of 5PM and 8AM.
* The Toy Alexander is a guaranteed drop from Alexander - The Soul of the Creator (Normal or Savage).
* You can be mounted while traveling over the spawn locations as long as the Toy Alexander was summoned prior to mounting. If you disconnect or log-in already mounted, you'll need to dismount once to let the game automatically summon it again before re-mounting.
* You do not have to be on the ground to trigger a spawn, you can fly at any altitude as long as you go over the spawn locations below.
en.gandarewa:
* Aurum Regis Ore can be mined at the 'Mother of the Sheave' (Slot 6) with 'Truth of the Mountains' active between the Eorzean hours of 2AM/PM and 4AM/PM.
* Seventh Heaven can be harvested at 'The Lost Landlord' (Slot 1) with 'Truth of the Forests' active between the Eorzean hours of 4AM/PM and 6AM/PM.
* These nodes first have to be unlocked via Tome of Geological Folklore - Dravania and Tome of Botanical Folklore - Dravania. These are most easily obtained from Sundry Splendor vendors in the Aetheryte Plazas of past expansion cities under 'Gathering Supplies' > 'Folklore Items' (e.g. Ishgard).
* At least 600 Gathering is required to mine or harvest.
* The quota is for the number of successful gathering attempts, *not* on the number of items received. So spending GP on as many 'Solid Reason'/'Ageless Words' uses as you can will help meet it sooner.
* As with all quota triggers, a spawn after exactly 100 gathering attempts is not guaranteed if the window has not yet capped. Also a successful spawn attempt can occur before you complete all 100, due to other player activity in the zone counting towards it.
en.gunitt:
* Clionids are found in the north of the zone near the border with 'Kholusia'.
* Clionids must gain the 'Fully Enlarged' buff before they will use Buccal Cones on players. To do this, you must bring the Clionid near to the 'Deep-sea Leechs' that are nearby. The Clionid will first use Buccal Cones to "eat" the leeches and grow larger. After eating three, it gains the buff you need and will start eating you. 🙂
* Buccal Cones deals damage equal to your maximum HP. This means you will likely die once your spawn attempt is complete. Using tank invulnerability cooldowns or other shield/mitigation abilities are quick ways to do multiple spawn attempts in a row by taking multiple attacks.
* The chance that Gunitt will spawn per-attack when he's ready is very high, so ideally just do 2-3 attempts, then move on to other things. If you can't survive multiple attacks per attempt, setting your home point to 'The Ondo Cups' will help speed things up and save on Gil.
* This is also a good opportunity to get your The Kindness of Strangers V achievement with the 'Good Samaritan' title if you don't have it. Resurrect your comrades as they die repeatedly!
en.ihnuxokiy:
* The Morpho is a rare drop from the final boss in The Lost City of Amdapor (Hard). You can complete this unsynced for faster attempts.
* It can also be obtained inside Gold-haloed Sacks and Silver-haloed Sacks from the Heaven-on-High Deep Dungeon, playing Kupo of Fortune or inside Fête Presents from Ishgard Restoration, inside Material Container 3.0s from Grand Company Seals at Captain rank, or off the Market Board for Gil.
* You can be mounted while traveling over the spawn locations as long as the Morpho was summoned prior to mounting. If you disconnect or log-in already mounted, you'll need to dismount once to let the game automatically summon it again before re-mounting.
* You do not have to be on the ground to trigger a spawn, you can fly at any altitude as long as you go over the spawn locations below.
en.ixion:
* As there is no specific spawn trigger, there is no way to directly cause this FATE to spawn. You will need to camp and wait in the zone during the open window.
* When 'A Horse Outside' spawns, the weather in The Lochs will change to 'Quicklevin'. This is a unique weather condition that will always override the normal weather while the FATE is present.
* Like other boss FATEs, 'A Horse Outside' does not appear on the map, only on the minimap as you near its location.
* Initially, Ixion has an invulnerability shield that prevents it from taking any damage. This can only be removed by using a Stygian Ash, which is a random drop from Gazelleskin or Gaganaskin maps, as well as purchasable from other players on the Market Board. Only a single item from a single player is required to commence the FATE.
* Using a Stygian Ash guarantees you Silver contribution, even if the shield is already removed, and even when you're not in a group. This can be used as a means to help get Gold when you're unable to join a group (e.g. you're in a queue for a duty).
en.ixtab:
* The Ronkan mobs can all be found in the areas outside 'The Great Pyramid of Ux'ner', in and around 'The Morning Stars' in the north-east of the zone.
* As with all quota triggers, a spawn after exactly 300 kills is not guaranteed if the window has not yet capped. Also a successful spawn attempt can occur before you kill 100 of each, due to other player activity in the zone counting towards it.
en.kaiser_behemoth:
* Unlike Nandi, the minion *must* be the Behemoth Heir.
* The Behemoth Heir can be purchased for 400 Centurio Seals at 'The Forgotten Knight' in 'Ishgard'.
* You can be mounted while traveling over the spawn locations as long as the Behemoth Heir was summoned prior to mounting. If you disconnect or log-in already mounted, you'll need to dismount once to let the game automatically summon it again before re-mounting.
* You do not have to be on the ground to trigger a spawn, you can fly at any altitude as long as you go over the spawn locations below.

You will know they have spawned when the system message ``The minions of an extraordinarily powerful mark are on the hunt for prey...`` appears in your chat after killing the S-Rank. They will spawn in the four locations represented as blue dots on the map page.
* All four have to be engaged in combat within five minutes or else they will withdraw.
